content.text: I’ll check your KDE session, installed input-method packages, and available Mozc package, then install/configure the smallest required set. I’ll avoid changing unrelated locale settings.

arguments.command:
printf '%s
' '--- OS ---'; source /etc/os-release && printf 'NAME=%s
VERSION=%s
' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$VERSION_ID"; printf '%s
' '--- session ---'; printf 'XDG_SESSION_TYPE=%s
XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=%s
LANG=%s
' "$XDG_SESSION_TYPE" "$XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP" "$LANG"; printf '%s
' '--- installed packages ---'; pacman -Q | rg '^(fcitx|ibus|mozc|plasma).*' || true; printf '%s
' '--- processes ---'; pgrep -a 'fcitx|ibus' || true; printf '%s
' '--- env ---'; env | rg '^(GTK_IM_MODULE|QT_IM_MODULE|XMODIFIERS|SDL_IM_MODULE)=' || true

printf '%s\n' '--- package candidates ---'; pacman -Ss '^(extra|cachyos|chaotic-aur)/.*(fcitx5-mozc|mozc)' || true; printf '%s\n' '--- config files ---'; fd -H -d 3 'fcitx|environment|plasma-localerc' "$HOME/.config" 2>/dev/null | head -80
